user.title: Set up HomeIntent
user.description: Set up HomeIntent as a local conversation agent for Home Assistant Assist.

init.title: Configure HomeIntent
init.description: Configure devices, safety, and local delivery channels. HomeIntent rules remain visible in the Home Assistant automation UI. What HomeIntent has learned and may do without asking is shown and controlled in the Learning Center in the sidebar (HomeIntent, path /homeintent).

data.selected_entities: Fixed entity selection (empty: everything exposed to Assist, automatically)
data.control_user_ids: Users allowed to control devices (empty: all)
data.custom_aliases: Additional spoken aliases (Alias = entity.id, one per line)
data.allow_non_admin_critical: Allow critical actions for authenticated non-admin users
data.allow_non_admin_automations: Allow non-admin users to create automations
data.routine_detection_enabled: Enable local routine and anomaly detection
data.documents_directory: Allowed subdirectory inside the Home Assistant configuration directory
data.room_aware_voice_enabled: V12: Room-aware voice (only with unambiguous room evidence)
data.attention_budget_enabled: V12: Attention budget, grouping and cooldown
data.quiet_hours_enabled: V12: Respect quiet hours (critical warnings always)
data.standing_permissions_enabled: V12: Allow explicitly confirmed standing permissions
data.critical_multi_channel_enabled: V12: Critical warnings on multiple channels
data.proactive_entry_open_minutes: V12: Minutes before an open garage or gate is reported
data.proactive_appliance_entities: V12: Appliances (program state, power sensor in W or running binary sensor)
data.proactive_person_room_sensors: V12: Person room sensors (person.x = sensor.y, one line per person)

error.invalid_alias_rules: The alias rules are invalid or one alias points to multiple targets.
error.invalid_house_relations: The configured house relations are invalid.
error.invalid_agent_options: Quiet hours, event categories, or the document directory are invalid.

delete_automation.name: Delete automation
delete_automation.description: Internal service used by self-deleting HomeIntent automations.

automation_id.name: Automation ID
automation_id.description: ID of the automation to delete.

record_automation_run.name: Record automation run
record_automation_run.description: Internal service used by run-limited HomeIntent automations.

enable_automation.name: Re-enable automation
enable_automation.description: Internal service used to resume temporarily paused HomeIntent automations.

proactive_message.name: Process proactive agent message
proactive_message.description: Creates a deduplicated local agent situation.

recheck_agent_event.name: Recheck agent situation
recheck_agent_event.description: Internal service for snooze and fresh state checks.

bind_user_context.name: Bind user, person, and push target
bind_user_context.description: Stores an explicitly confirmed local user, person, and push mapping.

set_household.name: Set household persons
set_household.description: Stores the confirmed person.* scope used for nobody-home goals.

save_routine.name: Save confirmed routine
save_routine.description: Stores a local routine made of typed, explicitly confirmed steps.

save_comfort_profile.name: Save confirmed comfort profile
save_comfort_profile.description: Stores explicitly confirmed local comfort ranges.

delete_monitor_goal.name: Delete monitor goal
delete_monitor_goal.description: Deletes a persistent HomeIntent monitor goal by goal ID.

fixed_entity_selection.title: HomeIntent uses a fixed entity selection
fixed_entity_selection.description:
The HomeIntent options store a fixed list of entities. {count} entities exposed to Assist are therefore invisible to HomeIntent (e.g. {examples}).

HomeIntent 7.1.2 pre-filled this list by mistake when options were saved. If you do not want a fixed selection, open HomeIntent → Configure, clear "Fixed entity selection" and save: HomeIntent then follows the Assist exposure automatically again.
